note: Fixed retrieval questions with known answers. NEVER edit a question once a baseline has been run against it — a changed question breaks comparability, which is the entire point. To add questions, append new ones with new ids and note the run where they first appear.
scoring: An answer counts as correct when it contains ALL of `mustInclude` (case-insensitive). Keep those keys short and unambiguous so the grader stays honest.

tiers.always-on: Answerable from AGENTS.md alone, which is auto-loaded every session. Tests whether the agent USES the context it already has. If these fail, the always-on file is too long or too vague — not an indexing problem.
tiers.routed: Requires navigating from an index to an owning doc. THIS IS THE TIER THAT MEASURES YOUR INDEXING. Changes to INDEX.md, APP_LOCATIONS.md, recipes/INDEX.md or app AGENTS.md files should move these numbers.
